description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Trailer Ops provides a specialized Dealer Management System and website hosting platform for the trailer dealership industry. The Frontend Developer - Client Relations role involves creating and maintaining responsive customer-facing websites, implementing design changes, troubleshooting front-end issues, and working directly with customers to understand and fulfill their website needs.
Customer-facing frontend developer building responsive websites, translating client requirements, and troubleshooting interface issues

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain responsive customer-facing websites and interfaces
• Implement website designs, layouts, and requested changes
• Work with customers to understand website requests and requirements
• Communicate directly with customers by phone and email
• Explain technical concepts in a clear, professional, and friendly way
• Troubleshoot website and front-end issues
• Coordinate with our development team on larger features and integrations
• Manage multiple customer requests and projects at the same time
• Provide a high level of customer service throughout the development process

Requirements:
• Strong knowledge of  HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Responsive Websites
• Excellent eye for design, layout, and user interface best practices
• Proficiency with  Photoshop  or other graphic design tools
• Strong communication skills and ability to work independently on multiple projects

Preferred:
• Experience with  PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap  is a big plus
